title: awsec2/create-vm input
description: Input Contract for the awsec2/create-vm Action (charter §2.2 headline example, ADR-0031). AWS credentials inject as a CredentialRef (§2.5), not params.

endpoint.description: override API endpoint (dev: the moto stand-in)

projectKind.description: estate overlay (ADR-0058 §6): the Entity kind the built instance projects AS (e.g. host), so a fleet View selects it. Empty keeps the native 'instance'.

projectLabels.description: estate overlay labels carried on the built instance's Run-provenance projection — the stratt.intent/instance correlation key + fleet labels the Run may own (§2.1 per-key ownership).

subnetId.description: Declared placement (ADR-0058/0059 D5, ADR-0123 D2): the subnet to launch into. EMPTY MEANS UNPLACED and is normal — placement is emitted complete with empty axes where the Intent declares nothing, so a shared builder can bind it without a conditional. Added by PRV-1: the provisioning seam already rendered this into the Action's params and the closed Contract rejected it, so every Intent/Compute build failed at launch.

availabilityZone.description: Declared placement: the AZ to launch into. Empty means unplaced (see subnetId).

securityGroupIds.description: Security groups to attach. Absent/empty leaves the VPC default.

keyName.description: Name of an ALREADY-IMPORTED key pair (awsec2/import-key-pair) whose public key the instance should authorize. Only the NAME crosses here — no key material, ever (§2.5).
